heroSub: Seven budget Chumphon stays in town we've reviewed, all scoring 8.3+ — from a 9.2 hostel at ฿350 a bed and a small hotel a short walk from the station to town hotels with a pool and a good breakfast. From around ฿350–1,300/night, ranked by value.
introH2: 🎒 Can you do Chumphon on a light budget, and how do you pick a stay that's good value?
introHtml: Chumphon is the gateway to the south and the ferry connection to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan, where most travellers just overnight before the boat — which means a budget stay in town is the real hero here. There's no need to pay resort prices if your plan is passing through or catching the ferry. The good news: the town has everything from a hostel at ฿350 a bed and small hotels a short walk from the station to town hotels with a pool and a good breakfast in the low hundreds-to-thousand baht range, all scoring 8.3+. The key to picking value is three things — (1) how far it is to walk to the station and night market, since closer means less on transport · (2) whether you just need somewhere to crash for a night (hostel/basic room) or want a pool and breakfast (pay a little more) · and (3) whether the stay helps book your onward island ferry, which saves time and fees. This guide brings together 7 budget Chumphon stays we've reviewed, all scoring 8.3+, ranked by value — every pick comes from reading real guest reviews, with prices compared across 3 sites and direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Chumphon has no metro — the main ways to get around are by train, road and boat. The advantage of the budget stays in this guide is that they're all in Chumphon town, within walking distance of the railway station, night market and restaurants, so you don't need a car to get around or connect to the island ferry. Most travellers take the train down to overnight in town before catching the ferry to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan from the Pak Nam pier. Stays within walking distance of the station: Chumphon Palace (~300 m), Salsa Hostel (~580 m), Nana Buri · Morakot · A-Te · Chumphon Gardens · Loft Mania (around a 10–12 minute walk). Many help book ferry tickets and onward transfers to the pier. If you want the out-of-town beaches at Sai Ri or Thung Wua Laen, a rental car is best — but this budget set is all about in-town convenience.

entries.addr: 25/42 Krom Luang Chumphon Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: We open with the best-value pick — Salsa Hostel is the highest-scoring stay in this set at 9.2, from just ฿350 a bed, ideal for backpackers overnighting before the island ferry. Real reviews agree on the owner and staff who help a great deal and speak fluent English, booking ferry tickets to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan with no added fee, and the cleanliness of both rooms and common areas. It's central, within walking distance of the station and night market. Worth knowing: it's a small hostel, the shared dorms have some noise, and there's no pool or sea view.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more privacy, pick the Standard Room double or the quieter 4-bed dorm. Have the owner book your Koh Tao ferry at check-in — it's easy and fee-free. Bring earplugs if you're in a shared dorm.

entries.addr: 328/15 Pracha Uthit Rd, Tha Taphao, Mueang Chumphon
entries.storyHtml: For the cheapest private room in town, Chumphon Palace Hotel is excellent value — 8.9 from just ฿450. Its strength is a location only 300 metres' walk from the railway station, making it a tidy one-night base before the ferry to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan. Real reviews praise the clean rooms, comfy beds, easygoing staff who help with boat and car tickets, and free parking. Worth knowing: the building is older with plain decor, the air-con in some rooms is an older model that doesn't cool enough on the hottest days, and there's no pool.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a room in better condition, pick the refurbished Superior Room. On very hot days, ask for a room with newer air-con. Have the staff book your island ferry ticket — it's easier than arranging it yourself.

entries.storyHtml: The best value for space in the sub-฿1,000 range — Morakot Hotel is a central town hotel that genuinely stands out for rooms larger than the price suggests and bathtubs that are rare at this budget, scoring 8.4 from ฿650. Real reviews praise the very spacious rooms, many with bathtubs, plus a pool, buffet breakfast and free parking, with a location within walking distance of the station and night market. Worth knowing: the building is ageing and room quality differs clearly between the old and new wings, and the walls are fairly thin — it suits people focused on value and location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a new-wing room for clearly better condition and furniture than the old wing. For a spacious room with a bathtub, pick a Superior. As walls are thin, ask for a room away from the corridor for quiet.

entries.storyHtml: A ฿700 room that gets you space and a good breakfast — Chumphon Gardens Hotel is a town hotel that stands out for spacious rooms, a budget price, easy parking and a much-praised breakfast, scoring 8.6 from 114 reviews. Real reviews praise the varied, tasty buffet breakfast, spacious rooms with soft beds, and roomy parking, in a location near the market and station. It's a tidy stopover mid-journey or before the island ferry. Worth knowing: the building is older, some mattresses are starting to sag, and there's no pool.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book a Superior with Breakfast — it's better value given how praised the breakfast is. Some mattresses are starting to sag, so it's fine to compare rooms at check-in. Driving in, the parking is roomy and easy.

entries.storyHtml: For a stay so many travellers rely on you can book it with confidence — Nana Buri Hotel is the most reviewed stay in this set, 198 reviews from ฿900, which shows it's a stay travellers genuinely use. Real reviews praise the spacious, clean, good-value rooms, a location within walking distance of the station and night market, easygoing staff who help with boat and bus tickets, plus breakfast and free parking. Worth knowing: the walls are fairly thin so you'll hear neighbours, the beds are on the firm side, and there's no pool — it's a pure town hotel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more space, pick a Superior or Suite. As the walls are thin, ask for a higher floor or an inner room for quiet. The beds are firm, so if you need a soft mattress, compare elsewhere.

entries.storyHtml: For a boutique-design stay that stays affordable — Loft Mania Boutique Hotel is a loft-style boutique hotel in central Chumphon with a pool and jacuzzi and spacious rooms from ฿1,100, scoring 8.3. It stands out for travellers using Chumphon as a stopover before the island ferry — real reviews praise the location within a 10-minute walk of the station with food easy to find, the infinity-style pool with jacuzzi, spacious clean rooms many with a kitchenette, and staff who help arrange cars and ferry tickets. Worth knowing: breakfast isn't the strong point, some rooms have noise, and the shower pressure is light for some.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more space and a kitchenette, pick a Loft Suite or Family Suite. The breakfast choice is limited, so it's easy to eat out nearby in town. Some rooms have air-con or system noise — you can ask to switch if it bothers you.

entries.storyHtml: We close with the top-of-budget pick that still delivers value — A-Te Chumphon Hotel is a town hotel with a swimming pool, a good breakfast and spacious, clean rooms, scoring 8.7 from 184 reviews. Many real reviews call the buffet breakfast the best they've had, with big rooms, large windows and strong water pressure, plus a rare pool right in the centre. It's a tidy overnight base before the island ferry. Worth knowing: some rooms can smell musty and there's no dinner restaurant on site, so you'll walk out in the evening (we place it last because it's the priciest in the set, but you get the best pool and breakfast in return).
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To step into the pool from your room, pick the Deluxe Twin Pool Terrace or a Pool Access Room. If a room smells musty, run the air-con or ask to switch. For dinner, the night market is a short walk away.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about budget Chumphon hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which budget Chumphon stay is the best value?
faq.a: By value (score for the price), Salsa Hostel from ฿350 a bed at 9.2 is the best value in this set · For a cheap private room, Chumphon Palace ฿450 (8.9) is 300 m from the station, and Morakot ฿650 (8.4) with spacious rooms, bathtubs and a pool is great value too

faq.q: ❓ How much do budget Chumphon hotels cost?
faq.a: In this guide, prices start around ฿350–1,300/night · The lightest are Salsa from ฿350 (dorm bed), Chumphon Palace ฿450, Morakot ฿650 and Chumphon Gardens ฿700 · The pool/boutique end is Nana Buri ฿900, Loft Mania ฿1,100 and A-Te ฿1,300 · All are approximate starting rates outside peak; over long weekends and busy southern-travel periods they rise noticeably

faq.q: ❓ Where should I stay to overnight before the Koh Tao–Koh Phangan ferry?
faq.a: Pick a town stay within walking distance of the station that helps with ferry tickets · Salsa Hostel ฿350 books tickets to Koh Tao and Koh Phangan with no added fee · Chumphon Palace ฿450 is 300 m from the station · and Nana Buri ฿900 has staff who help with boat and bus tickets — all three are tidy one-night bases before the boat from the Pak Nam pier

faq.q: ❓ Are there budget Chumphon hotels with a pool?
faq.a: Yes · Morakot Hotel ฿650 has a town pool plus spacious rooms with bathtubs · Loft Mania ฿1,100 has an infinity pool with a jacuzzi · and A-Te ฿1,300 has a town-centre pool with a praised breakfast · The lighter-budget stays (hostel and small hotels) mostly have no pool, leaning on location and price instead

faq.q: ❓ Do I need a car to do Chumphon on a budget?
faq.a: If you stay in town as in this guide, no car is needed — every stay is within walking distance of the station, night market and restaurants, and many help arrange onward transfers to the pier or beaches · But if you want the out-of-town beaches at Sai Ri or Thung Wua Laen, several tens of minutes away, a rental car or motorbike is far more convenient

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking budget Chumphon hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion at any given time, so compare all 3 before booking every time — all 7 stays in this guide can be booked directly on all 3 sites, and each review page has price-comparison links, which can save tens to hundreds of baht a night
